title: Widget issue
body:
Hi,

I’m having an issue with the widget in HabitMinder. I used to be able to check in habits directly from the widget by tapping it, but now tapping the widget doesn’t do anything.

I’ve already tried removing and re-adding the widget, restarting my phone, and opening the app, but the issue is still there.

Could you let me know if this feature has changed or if it’s a bug? Also, is there anything else I can try to fix it?

For reference, I’m using an iPhone with the latest iOS version.

Thanks for your help.
author: Theo in Toronto

body: That this app would blast me with the push to buy premium each time I opened it, I would not have installed it. title: Not recommended
body: I wish there was a trial for this app. As soon as you download you’re prompted to pay for a year at half price. I did not see another option for other plans. I thought the app would work for me but realized within a day that it was not the right app for me. It’s too much work to manage habits. Some habits, like reading you have to remember to start a timer as example. There is no option to contact the company to get a refund and no support offered.

title: HabitMinder
body: I had used this app for a daily meditation practice timer for several years. I have just deleted it, it was recently revised to be next to Useless. I meditate in 30-minute intervals. author: Kill3rZzz

title: Annoying reminders for things it knows I’ve done
body: I regret paying for this app. I’m constantly getting reminders throughout the day to do things that app knows, or should know, that I’ve done. So annoying. Example: the app reminds me to stand, or to walk, when it should know based on my steps being tracked that I’ve met the goal for the day. This app is NOT smart. It’s a glorified checklist with no consideration given to data available to the app that speaks to what I have actually accomplished during the day. You might as well just set reminders in your calendar to do the things you want to do…it’s the same thing.

title: Effortless and effective
body:

If I could recommend something to the developers though it would be to have the option to create a habit which you can create steps for instead of a basic count. Once you finish those steps then you complete the habit. Even without this though I’d still give this app a 5 star.

author: Samantha Pedersen

title: Great app so helpful. Would like one small feature
body:
App has been best out of all the habit apps I have tried.

Love how simple it is and I can define what I am trying to do. Other apps were too much structured to the habits they told me or overly complex.

The app should be easy if you’re trying to use it to make habits or else it just gets in the way and hampers the whole process.

Can’t recommend enough. But you have to want it to, the app just provides a gentle nudge and some feel good once you mark them off. 

Don’t set your first goals too high or too many. Set yourself up for success then grow from there. To make big change take small steps.

*** to the devs ***
One feature that I would love, is minor but would make stuff so good. If you could move the habits in the list up and down. Like you do in other OS things (like weather) so I can have them imputed then move their order from top to bottom so can group then based on time in my day I want to do.
